question: Can you calculate the median from the highest season goals of each team?
sql:
WITH team_season_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        season,
        SUM(home_team_goal) AS goals
    FROM Match
    GROUP BY home_team_api_id, season
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        season,
        SUM(away_team_goal) AS goals
    FROM Match
    GROUP BY away_team_api_id, season
),
team_season_total AS (
    SELECT 
        team_api_id,
        season,
        SUM(goals) AS total_goals
    FROM team_season_goals
    GROUP BY team_api_id, season
),
team_max_season_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        team_api_id,
        MAX(total_goals) AS highest_season_goals
    FROM team_season_total
    GROUP BY team_api_id
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY highest_season_goals) AS median_value
FROM team_max_season_goals

Now I understand the data. Let me work through the logic:

1. For each team and each season, calculate total goals scored (home_team_goal when the team is home, away_team_goal when the team is away)
2. Find the highest season goals per team (max total goals across all seasons)
3. Calculate the median of those values

WITH team_season_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        season,
        SUM(home_team_goal) AS goals
    FROM Match
    GROUP BY home_team_api_id, season
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        season,
        SUM(away_team_goal) AS goals
    FROM Match
    GROUP BY away_team_api_id, season
),
team_season_total AS (
    SELECT 
        team_api_id,
        season,
        SUM(goals) AS total_goals
    FROM team_season_goals
    GROUP BY team_api_id, season
),
team_max_season_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        team_api_id,
        MAX(total_goals) AS highest_season_goals
    FROM team_season_total
    GROUP BY team_api_id
)
SELECT * FROM team_max_season_goals
ORDER BY highest_season_goals DESC
LIMIT 20
"}
